steps.description: HAMATTEST-02 verifies that a head-bound shared rereview decision takes ownership before historical hammer routing, including at the review ceiling, while carried clean verdicts reach ordinary merge eligibility. LEASEFAIR-03 verifies the per-base history records closer/daemon grants and releases, including the retry hold. LEASEFAIR-02 verifies the closer retry retains its lease across a synthetic CI wait after daemon priority service; another daemon cannot overtake it. Focused rendered-shell fixtures in test/hammer-self-rebase.test.mjs cover touching/disjoint advances, fresh exact-head range evidence, one shared CI deadline including rebase time, and conflict/red/expiry release without live GitHub. LEASEFAIR-01 verifies a daemon priority reservation cannot preempt a holder and wins the next acquisition over an earlier closer waiter. Synthetic broker receipt recovery survives a lost acquire response without a delivery row or run record; live processes renew, failed releases retain the journal, and confirmed drain retries release with a positive acknowledgement. ITP-11 also verifies two synthetic ready OS holders carry one canonical gemini-reviewer identity; independent pools cannot acquire a third lease, cleanup/drain failures retain the durable fence until readiness succeeds, an in-flight release retains its local receipt during concurrent readiness, a terminal pre-spawn record without a PGID allows re-admission, and failed release immediately isolates its drained holder and starts authenticated recovery. No credentials, live broker, enrollment or live provider calls. HAMATTEST-02 regression fixtures also execute the pushed-attestation CLI with conflicting ambient credentials, refuse a fallback push after known API publication, recover transient post-rebase snapshots, and verify failed/refused exact-head reviews accumulate idle time through bounded recovery and one exhaustion page.

REMEDBRANCH-01 verifies unresolved remediation head metadata holds pending without a worker or round charge and recovery carries the resolved branch; three failed lookups stop without a worker or round charge, and confirmed publication leaves the review gate pending; settled clean reviews bypass branch reads and legacy holds, and unchanged workspace HEADs reject publication debt inferred from reply hashes. HAMNOREREVIEW-01 verifies the retired handoff helper requests no review, releases its dispatch lease for hammer retry, and the full reviewed-to-built range passes the real range and eligibility predicates before a disposable Git merge. BRANCHPROBE-01 verifies null head metadata uses Git confirmation, unknown reads defer without consuming budget, and recovery dispatches; unidentified forks stop for operator inspection after six hours without charging launch budget or continuing same-head probes. Terminal scratch cleanup preserves a draining recorded process and removes its private pytest tree after exit; aged terminal cwd-timeout recovery; oldest-first scratch cursor resumes across passes and restarts with independent ledger timeouts; TERMLEASE-01 same-pass terminal superseded/failed-without-merge/deferred lease reclaim with finished launches and exclusive reacquisition; terminal no-merge lease/capacity release and wake re-arm; armed auto-merge retains ownership inside the 30-minute lease window and releases at expiry; unreadable fresh launches reserve capacity.

HAMREDCI-01: proven final-round red-CI reason admission works with and without non-blocking findings; blocking or unknown blocking findings and structural holds still refuse that route. HAMPROVCI-01 verifies failed-CI admission and direct round requeue preserve a completed comment-only final handoff and its strict hammer starting-base edge, even at the round cap; suppression without the canonical finalRound marker retains ordinary requeue handling. LEASELIVE-01: offline handoff smoke retains a 45-minute running closer lease, releases a terminal launch and exercises the execution-ceiling fallback without live state. LEASEDEADPID-01: dead pending watcher ownership releases final comment findings to hammer without lease writes; live pending ownership waits; foreign-host pending ownership expires by age without local PID probes using a numeric epoch-millisecond clock. CI-repair wake and ownership admit terminal failed conclusions on a stale reviewed head; an empty same-head verdict does not establish repair ownership; LAC-2081 verifies later refusals preserve earlier intent/lease/prompt evidence; keyed native reconciliation recovers receipts or settles proven prepared no-submission, while unknown reaches inspection without canceling ownership. Deterministic SIGKILL, replacement and lock fixtures remain in the offline unit suite. CEILINGPUSH-01 also verifies green moved-head ceiling wake admission independent of legacy exhaustion reason/snapshot and idempotent routing with the original reviewed head.

WATCHERTIMER-01 verifies a 20-repo poll at 5x load uses the already-scaled reviewer budget under a fixed 24-hour ceiling; milliseconds and converted seconds stay below Node's timer maximum even with Infinity policy caps. LOADAR-01 scales nominal operational bounds with the shared load-aware helper, including closure env overrides; confirmed live launches report still running at the effective bound without changing ownership or receipts. HAMCLOSEWAIT-01 verifies an existing final-round wait advances to a retained launch timestamp: no page at twenty minutes, exhaustion without progress after thirty; repeated future-dated timestamps cannot postpone a stall page. HAMCLOSEWAIT-02 verifies a running background launch borrows its already-sized execution window, successful settlement persists the launch timestamp across SQLite reopen, refusal restores original debt, and either path pages only once. Packaging stops retain unchanged deterministic refusals and fence ownerless recovery even with packaging-only audit history, without another page; changed inputs release persisted refusals. Production preflight retires legacy holds without audit history, and mixed transient predicates prevent pure infrastructure classification. Includes distinct fleet-stop-active and fleet-stop-merge-kill reasons, uncached ledger-independent refusal and matching file removal using disposable roots; activation also requires the registered watcher to adopt the reader and old hammers to drain.
